text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see, that explains the weight of that 
box... It was an iron paperweight.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It also doubles as a single-flower 
vase, so you can display small seasonal 
flowers... like mimosa, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The strength to pursue your ideals... yet 
alongside that, the warmth you shower upon 
us underclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I felt that iron was the fitting material 
to express Air Groove-senpai's virtues... 
which is why I chose it as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You really put a lot of thought into this, 
thank you. The Student Council involves a 
lot of desk work, so I shall treasure and 
make good use of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "By the way... Shakur. Why are you here?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... you picked out my 
birthday present together with Messiah, 
did you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...So, you would've been fine with a 
100kg lump of iron? A ridiculously huge 
one with flashy rose patterns, to boot."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I-I apologize for the trouble I caused 
back then... When I thought about giving 
something to Air Groove-senpai, I just 
couldn't help getting obsessively 
worried..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...You know as well as I do that once 
this girl falls down a rabbit hole, she 
just keeps sinking."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you went out of your way to 
correct the course. ...Either way, I 
should say it properly again. Messiah, 
Shakur. ...Thank you.
